d:
So.. I noticed that the people who upload this comic here are getting a little lax, so now of course I feel obligated to pick up the slack. This one isn't really my thing. The girls are all a bit cookie cutter with the same ginormous dobonhonkeros.
You can read the whole thing on the creator's website right here: https://reinbachart.com
If you really like this story, please support the official release in any way you can!
I'll upload the comic strips and extras in another gallery.
